lazy_source_evidence.observation: Queue launches later shell/R subprocesses with cwd=ROOT, so new workers read current files.

Post stage sources helpers when invoked and then starts scripts/run_environmetrics_figures.R with config path from repo; early R source load is not a guarantee that later stages retain an old version.
ENV_PROJECT_ROOT selects current helper paths; post modules and publication renderer sourced by fresh subprocess.

Standalone render entrypoint loads helper/style from cwd and writes to supplied outputs_dir. --run-dir expects post/outputs directory containing figure_manifest.csv; default rewrite_canonical is TRUE.
